criteria.text: After more than 3 confirmed unstarted capacity refusals, Check, remote lint and Try setup can still finish within their caller wait.
pdd spaces capacity retries by Retry-After within the caller deadline and interruption rules.
An accepted queued job is read by its original request ID, with its supplied queue place and busy slots shown as progress.
pdd never resends a check for capacity when it may have started.
The lint wait limit also bounds dead-owner reads and saving a request ID before submission, including the 90-second agent lint wait during Try setup.
When my lint wait ends for a local slot or maintenance, pdd names that wait and does not claim that the server stayed busy after 0 lint attempts.
Submissions by the same authenticated owner at the same runtime reuse a clear capacity observation for about 10 seconds.

cases.given: 4 confirmed busy refusals then success, each command kind separately
cases.required_observation: 5 attempts succeed, same source/options/caps; all IDs retained

cases.given: Retry-After 7 seconds; finite caller budget; interrupt during wait
cases.required_observation: no early POST, no POST past deadline/interrupt

cases.given: same ID queued with ahead 5/in_use 8/slots 8, then passed
cases.required_observation: one POST; progress 5 ahead/8 of 8; GET same ID

cases.given: lost POST, wrong ID, positive/unknown calls, incomplete accounting separately
agent 90 s; terminal Check; Try existing allowance
cases.required_observation: agent stops 90 s; terminal Check unlimited; no new Try flag

cases.given: agent Try has five-minute setup budget but lint deadline at 90000 ms; dead-owner GET starts at 89950 ms and does not answer
cases.required_observation: GET timeout <=50 ms, effective lint admission ends at 90000, no request-ID registration or lint/Try POST afterward, no 30-second overrun for another dead row; existing potential paid lease is retained

cases.given: agent Try lint reservation acquired; local request recording is contended until effective lint deadline 90000 ms, earlier than setup deadline
cases.required_observation: recording returns false at lint deadline, no lint .posted evidence or POST is authorized, unsent reservation can release; interruption has same no-send result

cases.given: Check, explicit lint and Try setup separately wait for local slot or maintenance until lint deadline before first lint POST; also interrupt variants
cases.required_observation: plain result names local-slot wait or maintenance as appropriate, no server-busy-after-0-attempts claim; zero check calls, no check/Try POST; retain mode-specific exits: deadline wait5, Check interruption after batch creation3, explicit-lint/Try busy interruption5, door125; JSON stdout remains valid with its existing schema

cases.given: same owner and origin, clear capacity at clock 0; submissions at 0, 9999 and 10000 ms
cases.required_observation: first two share one capacity GET; expiry permits refresh at 10000; no extra GET per POST inside TTL; ordinary authenticated admission and saved request evidence remain required

cases.given: concurrent same-owner submissions; separately changed authenticated owner or exact runtime origin/port; refreshed response announces maintenance
cases.required_observation: concurrent reads coalesce per cache scope; no reuse across owner/origin/port; later maintenance is respected; no credentials or cache fields leak into files or public JSON

cases.given: two public Try setups share a pending dead-paid-job observation at the same origin; the initiating GET takes 500 ms within its longer wait, while the later lint observer has only 50 ms left
cases.required_observation: the later observer stops at its own remaining wait without awaiting the initiating caller's longer GET; it records and submits no new request, retains the uncertain paid lease, and does not cancel or corrupt the shared read needed by the longer caller

cases.given: a capacity maintenance window clears; the next lint admission is confirmed unstarted lint-queue-full, whose retry wait reaches the caller deadline
cases.required_observation: the final finite message identifies the current server-capacity wait rather than the already-cleared maintenance window; preserve mode-specific exits, valid existing JSON, zero new check/Try POSTs and all prior request evidence

cases.given: public acquireRuntimeSlot receives a valid absolute deadline 2592000000 ms ahead and borrows a pending 150 ms probe; also exercise several bounded timer chunks, a null deadline and interruption separately
cases.required_observation: a long native deadline never overflows to a 1 ms timer, warns or expires acquisition early; use positive timer chunks at most 60000 ms and recheck the actual remaining deadline before ending the observer; null means no deadline, interruption still stops that observer without cancelling the shared read, and all timers/subscriptions are cleaned up

cases.given: Check, explicit remote lint and new Try setup separately receive an authoritative confirmed unstarted busy refusal after a POST, separately a confirmed not-started maintenance refusal; Ctrl-C occurs during the resulting retry pause, before caller deadline
cases.required_observation: text says Stopped. and identifies what was submitted and the confirmed unstarted outcome; it never claims the wait deadline ended or nothing was sent; retain saved IDs, raw receipts and known usage, existing mode-specific interruption exits (including explicit-lint/Try-lint busy5, Check after batch creation3, Try-POST busy3 and door125), valid existing JSON, no further POST and no resend

cases.given: a command has earlier confirmed completed work and separately an earlier potentially paid dispatch with unknown outcome, while a later confirmed busy or maintenance refusal is paused; Ctrl-C occurs in that pause; compare the existing after-admission-before-current-POST stop boundary
cases.required_observation: post-pause text says Stopped. with earlier submitted IDs and confirmed/unknown outcomes, preserves receipts and known/unknown accounting, retains every uncertain paid lease and its read-only recovery advice, and sends nothing further; before-current-POST text stays Stopped before sending. scoped to the unsent request without claiming earlier work was unsent; existing exits and JSON schema stay unchanged
